recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant lime green background featuring a large, white-outlined numeral '7' that acts as a window frame for a collage of diverse young adult characters. The typography is bold and modern, layered over the central graphic element.
coreVisualRelationships: The large numeral '7' serves as the primary container for the character portraits.
The lime green background provides a high-contrast field for the white-outlined frame.
The main title text overlaps the left edge of the numeral frame, creating depth.
Characters are arranged in a diagonal descent following the shape of the numeral.
coreInvariants: Thick white border around the central numeric container
Drop shadow behind the numeric frame to separate it from the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large numeral '7' dominates the center and right side, filled with a dense collage of characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red and white title logo positioned on the left-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left characters, follows the horizontal bar of the '7', then descends diagonally through the remaining cast members to the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample lime green space on the left and right margins focuses attention on the central figure.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for outlines and secondary text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red for the primary brand name and cheerleader uniforms
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with naturalistic skin tones and varied clothing colors within the frame.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' and 'l' are tightly kerned to touch or nearly overlap
The 'ee' pair is perfectly aligned horizontally
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same geometric sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight kerning potential.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid lime green background. In the center-right, place a large, thick white-outlined numeral '7'. Fill the interior of the '7' with a collage of diverse young adults in various poses (singing, holding props like footballs or pom-poms). Apply a soft drop shadow to the entire '7' shape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large geometric sans-serif title in lowercase on the left side, overlapping the edge of the '7'. The main word should be white with a thick red outline. Add secondary descriptive text in plain white below it.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent lime green?
Does the numeral '7' act as a frame for the characters?
Is the main title text lowercase and tightly kerned?
Is there a visible drop shadow behind the frame and text?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white border of the '7' is uniform in thickness.
Check that the red outline on the text is bold and distinct.
Verify that the characters do not spill outside the white border.
Confirm the drop shadow is subtle and not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid bright background + Large numeric container with white border + Ensemble collage inside container + Overlapping geometric sans-serif typography.
